title: Episode 19: The Great Diamond Hoax of 1872: When Tycoons Bought a Seeded Mountain
description: In 1872, two unassuming prospectors walked into the Bank of California with a leather bag of uncut diamonds and rubies. The discovery sparked a frenzy among the nation's wealthiest capitalists, including William Ralston, Charles Tiffany, and Baron Rothschild, who invested millions in a secret diamond field—until a brilliant government geologist discovered the mountain had been salted.
